description: Add a product with its URL and a one-line tagline: krawlup enriches remaining copy and icons asynchronously and adds it to the founder's dashboard. Every other field is optional; explicit values win over enrichment. Adding NEVER publishes: the product is submitted for admin review and goes live in the directory once approved. Requires the submit permission.

alternativesCustom.description: Competing products NOT listed on krawlup (name + URL, max 5).

categories.description: Up to three category ids (or slugs/names) from check_launch_readiness. Optional; the founder can tag the product later.

description.description: Short description (max 600 characters). Omit to use the scraped description.

founderXHandle.description: The founder's X/Twitter handle or profile URL.

name.description: Product name (max 40 characters). Omit to use the scraped site title.

platforms.description: Platforms the product is made for.

tagline.description: One-line tagline describing what the product does (required, max 120 characters).

twitterUsername.description: The product's X/Twitter handle (bare handle or profile URL)

name: add_product
